Drain, then reserve every cooked cube in the emptied saucepan, off the heat. Prepare the filling on the second burner. Use all this cooked potato in the finishing step. Use 350 ml water in this step.

Heat the allocated olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add 90% lean ground beef with garlic powder, table salt and break into small crumbles. Cook about 8-12 minutes, stirring, until substantial crumbles reach 160 F (71 C). Keep the measured cooking juices in the dish. Transfer every cooked piece and its measured pan juices to the clean heatproof filling bowl. Keep this bowl separate from raw-food utensils.

Return all cooked 90% lean ground beef from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Add ready-made plain tomato sauce to the skillet. Warm gently over low heat for about 2-4 minutes, stirring until the filling is evenly coated and hot.

Mash all drained potatoes with the allocated milk and butter in the saucepan. Put all hot cooked filling in the shallow dish, cover with every portion of mash and all allocated cheese. Bake at 400 F (200 C) for about 15-20 minutes until bubbling, lightly golden and 165 F (74 C) in the center.

Return all cooked boneless skinless chicken breast from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Split the tender microwaved potato. Spoon the complete hot filling and all Cheddar cheese onto it. Let the cheese soften against the hot filling. Serve the potato with all the filling.

steps.instruction: Use one scrubbed 250 g potato, weighed raw with skin. Prick several times with a fork and place on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave on high about 5 minutes, turning halfway. If still firm, continue in 1-minute increments until a fork enters the center easily. Let stand 3 minutes. Use oven mitts and direct steam away from your hands when splitting.

Cut boneless skinless chicken breast into strips no thicker than 1 cm; do not rinse raw poultry. Heat the allocated olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken with garlic powder, table salt and cook about 8-12 minutes, turning, until several thick centers reach 165 F (74 C). Transfer every cooked piece and its measured pan juices to the clean heatproof filling bowl. Keep this bowl separate from raw-food utensils.

Keep the cooked protein in its clean bowl. Prepare button mushrooms in the skillet. Use the listed prepared cuts. Heat the oil allocated to this step over medium-low. Cook for about 4-7 minutes, stirring, until the produce is tender and hot. Lower the heat if the pan catches; no extra oil is needed.

Return all cooked boneless skinless chicken breast from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Split the tender microwaved potato. Spoon the complete hot filling and all Swiss cheese onto it. Let the cheese soften against the hot filling. Serve the potato with all the filling.

steps.instruction: Start preheating the oven to 400 F (200 C). Cut the raw chicken into 1 cm pieces. Heat all oil in the skillet over medium and cook the chicken for about 8-12 minutes until thick centers reach 165 F (74 C). Reserve all cooked chicken and pan juices in the clean cooked-food bowl.

Slice the mushrooms and add them with all the pre-cooked plain peas to the same skillet. Cook over medium-low for 5-7 minutes until hot and mushrooms soften. Stir in the 10 g sauce flour and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Gradually stir in all broth, 50 g milk and 0.35 g salt. Simmer gently 3-5 minutes until thickened. Fold in all cooked chicken and juices, then transfer all hot filling to the shallow 1 liter ovenproof dish.

In a separate clean dough bowl mix the remaining 50 g flour, all baking powder and 0.15 g salt. Rub in all butter with a fork, then stir in the remaining 40 g milk just until combined. Divide every portion of dough into two equal rough mounds on top of the hot filling; leave small gaps so steam can escape.

Bake on the middle rack at 400 F (200 C) for about 20-25 minutes until biscuit tops are golden, their centers have no wet raw dough and the filling reaches 165 F (74 C). If needed continue baking until both checks pass. Rest 5 minutes, then serve all filling and both biscuits.

steps.instruction: Prepare Mushrooms in the skillet. Use the listed prepared cuts. Heat the oil allocated to this step over medium-low. Cook for about 4-7 minutes, stirring, until the produce is tender and hot. Lower the heat if the pan catches; no extra oil is needed.

steps.instruction: Use only the reserved bread amount shown below. Before handling raw egg, put bread flat in the clean, cool skillet, in fitting batches without overlap. Turn heat to low or medium-low. Toast dry; turn with the spatula when the underside is lightly golden and crisp. Toast the second side to the same cue. Watch continuously; reduce or turn off heat if browning too fast or smoking. Move each batch to clean serving plates. Add no oil, butter or toppings, and do not leave the empty nonstick pan heating between batches. Follow the pan's care instructions; if dry-food cooking is prohibited, this route is unavailable.

Turn off the burner. Use the spatula to clear loose bread crumbs onto the toast plates; let the pan cool enough that the measured oil will not smoke. Add only the oil allocated below, then return to low heat. Keep toast and clean plates separate from raw-egg utensils.

Whisk the allocated egg and salt in the raw-egg bowl. Cook in the oiled skillet on low to medium-low, folding gently until firm with no liquid egg and 160 F (71 C) in the center. Fold in all allocated cheese near the end. Turn off heat. Serve all reserved toast, cooked egg, cheese and measured pan oil on a clean serving plate.

steps.instruction: Cut the listed potato into 1 cm cubes. Simmer all the potato in the water allocated to this step for about 10-15 minutes, until a fork enters the centers easily. Drain, then reserve every cooked cube in the emptied saucepan, off the heat. Prepare the filling on the second burner. Every cube will be folded into the egg filling before assembly.

Beat Whole eggs in the raw-egg mixing bowl. Heat the allocated olive oil in the skillet over medium-low heat. Pour every portion of beaten egg into the skillet. Gently fold for about 3-5 minutes until firm curds form, no liquid egg remains and the center reaches 160 F (71 C). Transfer every cooked piece and its measured pan juices to the clean heatproof filling bowl. Keep this bowl separate from raw-food utensils.

Return all cooked Whole eggs from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Fold in every drained fork-tender potato cube from the saucepan; include the complete cooked yield of the listed raw potato. Add ready-made mild tomato salsa to the skillet. Warm gently over low heat for about 2-4 minutes, stirring until the filling is evenly coated and hot.
Take the skillet off the heat. Combine all Monterey Jack cheese with the filling after bubbling stops. Divide the filling among 3 soft corn tortillas. Serve any extra filling alongside.

recipe.timing_note: Fill the tortillas just before serving.

steps.instruction: Start preheating the oven to 400 F (200 C) with a middle rack and the listed baking tray ready. Preheating overlaps ingredient preparation.

Beat Whole eggs in the raw-egg mixing bowl. Heat the allocated olive oil in the skillet over medium-low heat. Pour every portion of beaten egg into the skillet. Gently fold for about 3-5 minutes until firm curds form, no liquid egg remains and the center reaches 160 F (71 C). Transfer every cooked piece and its measured pan juices to the clean heatproof filling bowl. Keep this bowl separate from raw-food utensils.

Return all cooked Whole eggs from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Add Ready-to-serve basil pesto, ready-made plain tomato sauce to the skillet. Turn the heat off and gently stir through the hot filling; do not fry or boil the pesto.

Lay all the weighed ready-to-eat pita portions intact on the baking tray. Add all the cooked filling and sauce and all the low-moisture whole-milk mozzarella. Bake at 400 F (200 C) until the edges crisp and the topping is hot.
After removing the cooked dish from the oven, add all the tomato.

Cook the soaked bread without crowding, turning until golden and the center is set and reaches 160 F (71 C); probe from the side. Place cooked toast on a clean plate. Cook any remaining egg mixture in the skillet until set and 160 F (71 C), then serve it with the toast.
Serve all the French toast with all the honey, raspberries and pistachios.

steps.instruction: Cut the listed potato into 1 cm cubes. Add the allocated cooking water, adding more potable cooking water only if needed to cover the potatoes. Prepare Mushrooms in the skillet. Use the listed prepared cuts. Heat the oil allocated to this step over medium-low. Cook for about 4-7 minutes, stirring, until the produce is tender and hot. Lower the heat if the pan catches; no extra oil is needed.

Return every drained fork-tender potato cube from the saucepan to the skillet filling. Turn gently over medium-low heat for about 4-6 minutes until hot throughout and coated with the filling. recipe.serve_and_store: Serve promptly. Put perishable leftovers in shallow covered containers in the refrigerator at 40 F (4 C) or colder within 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90 F (32 C). Follow the actual ingredient package storage limits. No recipe-specific shelf life has been tested.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 F (175 C). Brush the dish with all the allocated oil. Whisk the milk, egg, yogurt and honey, then stir in the oats, baking powder and salt. Spread evenly in the dish. Keep raw-egg utensils away from the ready-to-eat toppings.
Bake on the middle rack until the center is set and reaches 160 F (71 C), with a lightly golden top. Rest in the dish for 5 minutes. Check the center rather than relying on time.
Serve all the baked oats with all the apple, blueberries and walnuts.
